questions.stem: Convert the quadratic equation to general form: y = 2(x - 3)^2 + 5.
questions.solution: To convert the given equation to general form, we expand and simplify. The general form is y = ax^2 + bx + c.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake is forgetting to distribute the 2 to all terms inside the parentheses in the expansion.

questions.stem: Convert the quadratic equation to general form: y = -(x + 4)(x - 1).
